name: io.github.RolloutsAI/mails-agent-email
title: Mails.ai — Agent Email
description: A real inbox for AI agents: send, receive and thread email, behind a prompt-injection firewall.

environmentVariables.name: MAILS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your mails.ai API key. Use an mk_test_ key to run against the sandbox or an mk_live_ key to send real mail. Free key at https://mails.ai

environmentVariables.name: MAILS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the hosted mails.ai API; only needed for staging or self-hosted deployments.
